column1: #Supplementary Table 1 Summary of protein groups measured in at least one sample of the Genes & Health cohort

#.ref - indicates protein and precursor (pre.) data obtained including all possible peptides; .mac5 - excluding variant peptides with evidence that respective protein altering variants exist in the Genes & Health population down to a minor allele count (MAC) of 5; sd - standard deviation; cv - coefficient of variation; p.dip - p-value of a dip test for multi-modal distribution: cis.pQTL - whehter or not a cis-pQTL was identified; med.pred = median (and 25th and 75th percentil) value of predicted correlation coefficient across all protein groups measued; Olink ID - best correlating olink target; spear.olink = associated Spearman correlation coefficient; SomaLogic ID = best correlating aptamer ID; spear.soma = associated Spearman correlation coefficient
